name: EV-6B6
description: EV-6B6 (Eevee-Sixbeesix), known as Eevee, was a helpful and talkative EV-class droid who originally served the Pyke Syndicate aboard a Moraysian cruiser. The Moraysian cruiser was stolen by the mercenary Ledesmar, and EV-6B6 was thus forced to serve her. When members of the Spice Runners of Kijimi boarded the cruiser to locate Ledesmar, EV-6B6 encountered Poe Dameron and Zorii Bliss and led them to Ledesmar, but regretted having to do so. Dameron and Bliss rescued Eevee from Ledesmar, and the droid worked with their cell of the Spice Runners.
